{{Quote|My files include more than seventy unique civilizations, ranging from Avernio Three to Zakuul.|[[ARIES]]|<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=4}}</ref>}}
'''Avernio Three''' was a world located in the galaxy. At some point before roughly [[6000 BBY/Legends|6000 BBY]], the planet was chosen by the [[unidentified Iokath species]] as one of the testing sites for their weapons and Avernio Three's unique civilization was assaulted with the destructive force of [[Iokath]] weaponry.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Avernio Three is briefly mentioned in the Chapter IV of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1stm}}
